newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Health in online prescription deal.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Health in online prescription deal.

text.p: Advanced Health Corp said on Tuesday it and Physicians Online Inc have agreed to jointly market, distribute, and operate the first prescription writing service for physicians over the Internet.
Physicians' Online will offer Advanced Health's d-E-Systems' Internet Script Writer service to the 135,000 physician members of Physician Online's secure online network.
Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

Internet Script Writer is an electronic prescription writing service for use by physicians in their offices or wherever they can access the online service. The online service offers a list of preferred medications and a prescription drug history for patients, while checking drug interaction and formulary compliance, the company said.
Advanced Health said the prescription can be transmitted electronically to participating pharmacies.
